进入讨论并提出建议

在讨论中自然接话，提出可执行的建议，并根据对方反馈调整方案。

02 / 05

分段听懂

情节 01

发现问题

DDacey

I've put the welcome email on screen. It includes the setup link, the training invitation, and a list of support contacts. Does anything feel unclear before we send it on Thursday?

我把欢迎邮件放到屏幕上了。里面有设置链接、培训邀请和支持人员的联系方式。周四发送之前，你觉得有没有哪里不清楚？

TTim

Can I add something here? The information is useful, but there are three things asking for . A new customer might read the whole email and still not know what to do first.

我可以在这里补充一点吗？这些信息很有用，不过有三件事都需要读者关注。新客户可能看完邮件，还是不知道先做什么。

情节 02

提出方案

DDacey

That's a fair point. We need them to create an account before they can join the training. I kept everything together because I didn't want to fill their with several messages.

这个意见有道理。他们参加培训前需要先创建账号。我把内容放在一起，是不想用好几封邮件塞满他们的收件箱。

TTim

What if we start with one clear action? We could put account setup at the top and send the training invitation . That would make the first email shorter without removing any important information.

要不我们先给出一个明确的行动？可以把账号设置放在最上面，培训邀请另外发送。这样第一封邮件会更短，但重要信息并没有被删掉。

DDacey

Would that mean two emails on the same day? I'd rather leave a little space between them. Otherwise, customers may open the training message first and run into the same problem again.

那是不是同一天发两封邮件？我更希望两封之间留一点间隔。不然客户可能先打开培训邮件，又碰到同样的问题。

情节 03

小范围测试

TTim

We could send the invitation the next morning. For now, let's test the shorter version. I'll ask two colleagues who haven't seen this draft to read it and tell us what they would do next.

我们可以第二天上午发邀请。目前先测试简短版本吧。我会请两位没看过这份草稿的同事读一下，告诉我们他们下一步会做什么。

DDacey

I like that approach. Could you also check whether they can find the support address? We should keep that near the setup link, so they don't have to search for help if something goes wrong.

我喜欢这个做法。你能不能也检查一下，他们是否能找到支持邮箱？我们应该把它放在设置链接附近，免得还要到处找帮助，如果出了问题的话。

TTim

Yes, I'll keep that in the test. Just to be clear, we're not testing the design yet. We're checking whether the next step is and whether help is easy to find.

好的，我会把这一点也放进测试。确认一下，我们暂时不测试设计。我们检查的是下一步是否明确，以及能否方便地找到帮助。

情节 04

确定下一步

DDacey

Exactly. I'll the opening and move the invitation out. I'll leave the current draft in the shared folder as well, so we can compare both versions after your colleagues have read them.

对。我会修改开头，并把培训邀请移出去。现在的草稿也会留在共享文件夹里，这样我们可以比较两个版本，等你的同事看完后。

TTim

Great. I'll send you their feedback tomorrow afternoon. If the shorter version works, we can use it on Thursday and keep the training invitation as a separate .

好。我明天下午把他们的反馈发给你。如果简短版本有效，周四就用它，培训邀请作为后续邮件单独发送。
